R17.basis: Variance expansion is valid under pairwise zero covariance; no independence or normality needed.

R42.basis: Identical marginals do not give zero covariance; take all X_i equal to the same nondegenerate variable for n>1.

R63.basis: Six independent randomized pen contrasts; correct mean, t5 reference model and 44/64 sharp-null randomization test.

R88.basis: Randomization is at pen level; ten ordinal bird pairs per block are subsamples, not sixty independent treatment contrasts. Correct randomization P is 44/64.
